answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Every claim climbs the beacon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tide re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the quartz of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
